title: What Will It Take to Reopen Schools?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《DealBook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领导者，其中包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》App进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家锁定收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: The Biden administration is determined to quickly reopen America's public schools for in-person learning.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府决心迅速重新开放美国的公立学校，恢复线下教学。

sentences.en: To do that, it will have to convince teachers and their unions that returning to the classroom is safe.
sentences.zh: 为此，它必须说服教师及其工会，重返课堂是安全的。

sentences.en: My colleague, Dana Goldstein, on whether that's likely to happen.
sentences.zh: 我的同事达娜·戈尔德斯坦将探讨这种情况是否会发生。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月10日，星期三。

sentences.en: Dana, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 达娜，欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: I think it's been maybe like six months.
sentences.zh: 我想大概有六个月没来了吧。

sentences.en: Yes, I can tell you to the date because it was the last thing I did before I gave birth to my second baby in August was do a daily episode.
sentences.zh: 是的，我可以精确到具体日期，因为我在8月份生第二个孩子之前做的最后一件事，就是录制一期每日节目。

sentences.en: Oh my God, that's right.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，没错。

sentences.en: It was like literally on the eve of your child's birth.
sentences.zh: 那简直就像是在你孩子出生前夕。

sentences.en: I'm pretty sure I went into labor the next day, but the episode came out after I had the baby.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定我第二天就临盆了，但那期节目是在我生完孩子之后才播出的。

sentences.en: So people were like, wow, did you record that in the hospital room?
sentences.zh: 所以大家都在说，哇，你是在病房里录制的吗？

sentences.en: No, the answer is no.
sentences.zh: 不，答案是不是。

sentences.en: I'm not that much of a superwoman.
sentences.zh: 我没那么女超人。

sentences.en: We're not that kind of an operation.
sentences.zh: 我们也不是那种运作方式的节目。

sentences.en: So I want to start by asking you what the Biden administration's plan is for reopening schools.
sentences.zh: 所以我想先问你，拜登政府关于重新开放学校的计划是什么？

sentences.en: Well, President Biden has been quite clear.
sentences.zh: 嗯，拜登总统的态度一直很明确。

sentences.en: It should be a national priority to get our kids back into school and keep them in school.
sentences.zh: 让我们的孩子重返学校并留在学校，应该是一项国家首要任务。

sentences.en: He expects K through eight schools, he has said, to reopen within 100 days of his inauguration.
sentences.zh: 他说过，他期望八年级及以下的学校在他上任100天内重新开放。

sentences.en: Aggressive.
sentences.zh: 真激进。

sentences.en: Then my team will work to see that the majority of our schools can be open by the end of my first
sentences.zh: 然后我的团队将努力确保我们大多数学校能够在我的头

sentences.en: 100 days.
sentences.zh: 100天结束时开放。

sentences.en: That would put us in about mid-April.
sentences.zh: 那将使我们在4月中旬左右。

sentences.en: Masking, vaccinations, opening schools.
sentences.zh: 戴口罩、接种疫苗、开放学校。

sentences.en: These are the three key goals for my first 100 days.
sentences.zh: 这些是我头100天的三个核心目标。

sentences.en: And the reason it is so aggressive is that about a third of the nation's schools are still totally remote and another third are in some sort of hybrid scenario.
sentences.zh: 之所以这么激进，是因为全美大约有三分之一的学校仍然完全处于远程教学状态，另外三分之一处于某种混合模式中。

sentences.en: And about half of the kids are not in school across the United States.
sentences.zh: 全美大约有一半的孩子不在学校上学。

sentences.en: So even though we are nearing the first anniversary here of the pandemic, we still have a very severely disrupted education system in this country.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管我们即将迎来这场大流行的第一周年，这个国家的教育系统仍然受到了非常严重的破坏。

sentences.en: When we spoke with you last, all those months ago, we talked about the very specific requests
sentences.zh: 几个月前我们采访你时，我们讨论了公立学校教师为感到安心重返课堂而提出的具体诉求

sentences.en: that public school teachers were making to feel comfortable returning to the classroom.
sentences.zh: 公立学校的老师们在重返教室时感到了安心。

sentences.en: I remember face masks were one of their demands, temperature checks for people entering school buildings, low positivity rates for communities around the schools.
sentences.zh: 我记得戴口罩是他们的要求之一，进入学校建筑时要进行体温检测，学校周边社区的阳性率要低。

sentences.en: And so what is the status of those requests?
sentences.zh: 那么这些诉求现在进展如何？

sentences.en: I think it's important to say, first of all, that the low community positivity rates and just
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为有必要指出，低社区阳性率以及病毒得到控制的整体大背景，

sentences.en: the general background of the virus being controlled has not been achieved really in most parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 在全国大部分地区实际上都尚未实现。

sentences.en: So it's a raging pandemic right now.
sentences.zh: 所以目前这是一场肆虐的大流行。

sentences.en: It looks like the numbers are going down.
sentences.zh: 数字似乎在下降。

sentences.en: But of course, right now, we're also very concerned about the emergence of these new variants that appear to be highly transmissible.
sentences.zh: 但当然，现在我们也极其关注那些似乎具有高度传染性的变异株的出现。

sentences.en: So we've never really achieved as a country the first thing that the teachers and their unions wanted, which was community control of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为国家，我们从未真正实现教师及其工会想要的头一件事，那就是对冠状病毒的社区控制。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, the schools did already get quite a bit of federal money.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，学校确实已经获得相当多的联邦资金。

sentences.en: They used it for things like face masks, face shields, desk partitions, hiring nurses in some
sentences.zh: 他们将这些资金用于购买口罩、面罩、课桌隔板，在某些情况下

sentences.en: cases, all types of hygiene and all types of sort of staffing to meet some of these demands.
sentences.zh: 还聘请了护士，以及各种卫生措施和各种人员配置，以满足其中一些需求。

sentences.en: And in broad swaths of the country, particularly in the South and in more conservative areas, the schools are open and the students are in school.
sentences.zh: 在全国的广大地区，尤其是南部和更保守的地区，学校是开放的，学生也在校上课。

sentences.en: But in the places where the teachers unions are powerful, where teachers have this political voice, those are the places where the schools are much more likely to be closed.
sentences.zh: 但在教师工会力量强大、教师拥有政治话语权的地方，学校更有可能关闭。

sentences.en: They have again and again cited the fact that the virus remains out of control, that the country
sentences.zh: 他们一再指出这样一个事实：病毒仍然失控，国家

sentences.en: has not taken other difficult steps that they think it needs to take before schools are reopened,
sentences.zh: 尚未采取他们认为在学校重新开放之前必须采取的其他艰难步骤，

sentences.en: such as, you know, shutting down dining, shutting down movie theaters, basically curtailing other types of activity that spread the virus.
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道的，关闭堂食、关闭电影院，基本上是限制其他传播病毒的活动。

sentences.en: Am I right in thinking that teachers and their unions in this moment are exerting a pretty significant amount of influence over this school reopening decision making?
sentences.zh: 我这样想对吗：此时此刻，教师及其工会在学校重新开放的决策过程中施加了相当大的影响力？

sentences.en: And in a sense, they are deciding in many communities whether schools will be reopened for in-person instruction.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，他们在许多社区决定了学校是否会重新开放以进行线下授课。

sentences.en: They're kind of almost exercising a kind of veto.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎在行使某种否决权。

sentences.en: They're a very, very powerful force, perhaps the most powerful force in wide swaths of the country that are controlled by Democrats and where unions are powerful.
sentences.zh: 他们是一股非常非常强大的力量，在由民主党控制且工会强大的广大地区，这或许是最强大的力量。

sentences.en: In places like Texas and Florida and Arizona, where unions don't have that much power, it's a totally different story.
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州、佛罗里达州和亚利桑那州等工会没有那么大权力的地方，情况则完全不同。

sentences.en: Teachers have fought for mitigation measures and won them sometimes, but they haven't had that veto power over reopening schools.
sentences.zh: 教师们为减灾措施进行了抗争，有时也取得了胜利，但他们对重新开放学校并没有那种否决权。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And so at this point, despite all these reservations from teachers, what's the most powerful case being made from people in the Biden administration for reopening schools?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一点上，尽管教师有种种保留意见，拜登政府内部人士为重新开放学校提出的最有力的论据是什么？

sentences.en: What are they arguing?
sentences.zh: 他们的论点是什么？

sentences.en: Here's the basic argument.
sentences.zh: 基本论点是这样的。

sentences.en: It's been almost a year of this crisis.
sentences.zh: 这场危机已经持续了快一年。

sentences.en: Remote learning is not working for kids.
sentences.zh: 远程学习对孩子们不管用。

sentences.en: It is subpar compared to in-school learning.
sentences.zh: 与在校学习相比，它的效果较差。

sentences.en: It is hurting kids academically, emotionally, in terms of their mental health, and it's hurting disadvantaged children the moSt.
sentences.zh: 它在学业上、情感上以及心理健康方面伤害了孩子们，并且对弱势儿童伤害最深。

sentences.en: So whether your family can't afford a great internet connection at home, or maybe you have a disability that makes it hard for you to learn via a screen, or maybe you're just a
sentences.zh: 所以无论你的家庭承担不起家里优质的互联网连接，还是你可能存在某种残疾导致你难以通过屏幕学习，亦或是你只是一个

sentences.en: child under the age of eight or so, and you can't really manipulate the computer on your own.
sentences.zh: 八岁左右的儿童，根本无法自己操作电脑。

sentences.en: And so it requires having a parent or a grandparent next to you every minute of the day to kind
sentences.zh: 因此这需要有一位父母或祖父母在一天中的每分每秒都陪在你身旁，以某种方式引导你完成这种远程教学，

sentences.en: of guide you through this remote instruction in a way that has left your family reeling and maybe prevented an adult from working in a way that impacts the broader economy of
sentences.zh: 这让你的家庭感到崩溃，甚至可能阻碍了成年人工作，进而影响到你的城市、州乃至整个国家的更广泛经济。

sentences.en: your city, state, and the country.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是为什么学校确实需要重新开放的基本论点。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the basic argument for why schools do need to reopen.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我想这把我们引向了这样一个问题：身处教室并从中受益于你刚刚描述的所有事物所涉及的风险。

sentences.en: Which I think brings us to the question of the risks involved in being in a classroom and benefiting from all those things you just described.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们目前对这些风险的看法是什么。

sentences.en: And remind us of what the current thinking of those risks are.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得随着时间的推移，在与我们科学新闻部的同事和《纽约时报》健康记者的对话中，共识似乎是风险很低，

sentences.en: Because I feel like over time in conversations with our colleagues from the science desk and health reporters at the Times, that the consensus seems to be that the risks are lower,
sentences.zh: 比以前想象的要低得多。

sentences.en: significantly lower, than previously thought.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 在人们聚集的所有不同类型的环境中，学校似乎是最安全的场所之一，只要遵守戴口罩、保持社交距离、

sentences.en: Of all the different types of settings where groups of people come together, schools seem to be among the safest, as long as mitigation strategies like masking, social distancing,
sentences.zh: 勤洗手等减灾策略即可。

sentences.en: hand-washing are observed.
sentences.zh: 现在有很多国际数据来支持这一点。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of data now internationally to back that up.
sentences.zh: 来自欧盟以及美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）的新研究表明，

sentences.en: There are new studies from the EU, from the CDC here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 甚至在一些较大社区中病毒本身的阳性率相当高的地方，

sentences.en: Even in some places where the positivity rates for the virus itself in the larger community
sentences.zh: 只要遵守戴口罩等策略，新冠病毒在学校里的传播也非常有限。

sentences.en: were quite high, there was very limited spread of COVID in the schools when there was compliance, with strategies like masking.
sentences.zh: 当然，风险并非为零。

sentences.en: Now, the risk is not zero.
sentences.zh: 学校里并非完全没有新冠传播的病例。

sentences.en: There are not zero cases of spread of COVID in schools.
sentences.zh: 但这是一种风险与收益的权衡计算，随着更多证据的出现，它在不断被重新调整。

sentences.en: But it's a risk-benefit calculus that is constantly being readjusted as more evidence comes to light.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，我们讨论的所有这些研究，都不是针对这些新变异株进行的。

sentences.en: What I will say is that all of these studies that we're talking about, they were not conducted with these new variants.
sentences.zh: 它们是针对我们在过去10个月里在美国了解到的冠状病毒进行的。

sentences.en: They were conducted with the coronavirus we have come to know in the United States over the past 10 months.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个隐约逼近的未知数，也就是说，好吧，我们相当有信心，在带着我们一直以来与之共存的病毒的情况下，我们可以相当安全地运营学校。

sentences.en: So this is kind of a looming unknown, which is, okay, we are feeling pretty confident that we can operate schools pretty safely with the virus as we've been living with it.
sentences.zh: 但如果在接下来的几周和几个月里，我们面对的是一个截然不同的对手呢？

sentences.en: But what if over the next few weeks and months, we are dealing with a significantly different foe?
sentences.zh: 我想说这就是我们目前所处的时刻，在政治上以及在关于是否在那些仍然关闭的地方重新开放这一重大决策的健康影响方面，它是如此引人入胜。

sentences.en: And I would say that's the moment we're in right now, which is so interesting politically and in terms of the health impact of this really big decision about whether to reopen
sentences.zh: 那么，教师和教师工会如何回应这样一种共识——即特别是在新冠病毒出现变异之前，情况相对安全？

sentences.en: in those places that remain closed.
sentences.zh: 很明显，他们对全国许多地区的社区传播水平感到失望。

sentences.en: So how do teachers and teachers' unions answer the kind of consensus that, especially in a pre-coronavirus variant world, that the situation is relatively safe?
sentences.zh: 但鉴于学校仍然相当安全的理解，这些教师工会如何为他们对重返学校如此抗拒的决定辩护？

sentences.en: It's clear that they are disappointed with the level of community spread in many parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 全国各地有成千上万个这样的工会分支机构，所以你不能一概而论。

sentences.en: But given the understanding that schools remain pretty safe, how do these teachers' unions defend their decision to be so reluctant about returning?
sentences.zh: 但我一直在报道的是这种复杂的舞步：一些国家级工会领袖，比如美国教师联合会的兰迪·韦恩加滕，

sentences.en: So there's thousands of these union affiliates across the country, so you can't totally generalize.
sentences.zh: 开始接受这种科学共识，即在特定情况下学校可以是安全的，他们某种程度上把自己与拜登总统及其推动重新开放的立场结合在了一起。

sentences.en: But what I've been covering is this kind of complicated dance that has emerged where some of the
sentences.zh: 对于其中一些工会领袖来说，这改变了调门。当特朗普总统要求重新开放学校时，

sentences.en: national union leaders, like Randy Weingarten of the American Federation of Teachers, are coming
sentences.zh: 他们只是断然拒绝，并且对国会的共和党人没有给学校提供学校声称安全运营所需的资金感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: out to embrace this scientific consensus that schools can be safe under certain circumstances, sort of allying themselves with President Biden and his push to reopen.
sentences.zh: 但在芝加哥、费城、洛杉矶等地的基层，情况要复杂得多。

sentences.en: This is a change in tune for some of these union leaders who, when President Trump was asking
sentences.zh: 在这些由民主党管理的地区，许多地方工会仍然觉得这并不安全。

sentences.en: to reopen schools, were just sort of flatly rejecting of that and really were angry that he and the
sentences.zh: 他们不一定会被拜登政府或国家工会领袖的言辞所左右。

sentences.en: Republicans in Congress were not giving the money to schools that schools said they needed in order to do this safely.
sentences.zh: 他们真正想要的、正在为之奋斗的是为教师接种疫苗。

sentences.en: But on the ground, in places like Chicago, Philadelphia, Los Angeles, it is a lot more complicated.
sentences.zh: 在全国许多地区，他们真的希望教师在被要求重返课堂之前接种疫苗。

sentences.en: In those places which are run by Democrats, a lot of the local unions still do not feel it is safe.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，对许多这样的教师及其工会来说，此时此刻把事情做对，看起来就像是获得一支疫苗。

sentences.en: They are not necessarily swayed by the rhetoric of the Biden administration or of a national union leader.
sentences.zh: 这是他们衡量自己是否愿意让自己和学生重返课堂的安心程度的新标准。

sentences.en: And what they really want and what they're fighting for is teacher vaccination.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They really want their teachers to be vaccinated before they're required to go back into the classroom in many parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至把标准推得更高了一点。

sentences.en: So in other words, getting it right in this moment for many of these teachers and their unions looks like getting a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我交谈过的一些基层工会领袖说，嗯，我们并不确定一旦你接种了疫苗，

sentences.en: That is the new standard by which they are measuring their comfort with bringing themselves and their students back into the classroom.
sentences.zh: 你是否可能仍然会沾染微量的病毒并把它带回家传染给你的亲人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 例如，我采访了芝加哥的一位教师，他的妻子患有晚期乳腺癌，并已重新开始化疗。

sentences.en: And some are actually even pushing it a little bit beyond that.
sentences.zh: 目前他根本不清楚自己是否会被批准继续居家办公的照顾安排。

sentences.en: You know, some union leaders I've spoken to on the ground are saying, well, we don't know for sure if once you're vaccinated,
sentences.zh: 所以对这位教师来说，在没有接种疫苗的情况下重返工作岗位是他实在无法理解的事情。

sentences.en: you can't maybe still pick up a trace amount of the virus and bring it home and give it to your loved one.

sentences.en: Dana, you mentioned fights within the Democratic family and you mentioned Chicago.
sentences.zh: 达娜，你刚才提到了民主党家庭内部的争斗，还提到了芝加哥。

sentences.en: It does feel like that is where one of the biggest battles over school reopening has just unfolded.
sentences.zh: 感觉关于学校重新开放的最大争夺战之一正是在那里展开的。

sentences.en: So tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲是怎么回事吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Chicago is the third largest school district in the country.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥是全美第三大学区。

sentences.en: It has over 300,000 students.
sentences.zh: 它拥有超过30万名学生。

sentences.en: And the vast, vast majority have been out of school since the beginning of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数学生自大流行开始以来就一直没有返校上课。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter is that it is not sustainable.
sentences.zh: 事实是，这种情况是不可持续的。

sentences.en: And Mayor Lori Lightfoot really was clear.
sentences.zh: 市长洛里·莱特富特态度非常明确。

sentences.en: You know, she wanted to get back to school in January.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她希望在1月份恢复返校。

sentences.en: Thanks to an $8.5 million investment, every classroom and front office that will be used during this time will be equipped with its own HEPA purifier.
sentences.zh: 得益于850万美元的投资，在此期间将使用的每一个教室和前台办公室都将配备自己的HEPA（高效空气过滤器）净化器。

sentences.en: She said that the district had done a lot to improve ventilation and come up with all sorts of great cleanliness, hygiene, safety practices in school.
sentences.zh: 她表示，学区为改善通风做了大量工作，并在学校中推出了各种出色的清洁、卫生和安全实践。

sentences.en: And she wanted to offer parents the opportunity to get their, you know, K-8 kids back in school.
sentences.zh: 她希望为家长提供机会，让他们的K-8孩子重返学校。

sentences.en: It's thanks to measures like these that we are confident in our ability to support our students Monday and every day moving forward.
sentences.zh: 正是由于采取了这些措施，我们才有信心在周一以及未来的每一天都全力支持我们的学生。

sentences.en: And the unions were still asking for more.
sentences.zh: 然而工会仍在要求更多。

sentences.en: The union fired back this afternoon, saying what they've been saying for weeks.
sentences.zh: 工会在今天下午进行了反击，重申了他们数周以来的立场。

sentences.en: They don't buy it.
sentences.zh: 他们并不买账。

sentences.en: School is a place where we come together as a community.
sentences.zh: 学校是我们作为一个社区聚集在一起的地方。

sentences.en: And until it's safe to do so, I refuse to go back into the buildings.
sentences.zh: 在确保安全之前，我拒绝回到大楼里去。

sentences.en: I am making this decision not only for myself, but for the safety of my students and their families.
sentences.zh: 我做出这个决定不仅是为了我自己，也是为了我的学生及其家人的安全。

sentences.en: CPS and CTU stuck on four main issues.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥公立学校（CPS）与芝加哥教师工会（CTU）在四个主要问题上陷入僵局。

sentences.en: The timeline for reopening accommodations for staff with vulnerable household members, health metrics that would pause in person learning and vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 重新开放的时间表、为有脆弱同住家庭成员的员工提供的住宿安排、暂停线下教学的健康指标以及疫苗接种。

sentences.en: You know, they were asking for more accommodations for teachers with vulnerable relatives.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们要求为有易感亲属的教师提供更多便利条件。

sentences.en: They were asking for a vaccination for teachers before they had to return.
sentences.zh: 他们要求在教师返岗前为其接种疫苗。

sentences.en: You know, they were asking for even more stringent building safety measures.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们还要求采取更严格的建筑物安全措施。

sentences.en: And this really dug in over the past week.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一周里，双方的分歧变得更加根深蒂固。

sentences.en: We begin this hour 18 with that breaking news on the Chicago public schools.
sentences.zh: 我们在这个小时的开始关注关于芝加哥公立学校的突发新闻。

sentences.en: Bringing the city to the point of a potential strike.
sentences.zh: 这让这座城市面临潜在罢工的边缘。

sentences.en: CPS sending a letter out to staff and families saying, among other things, come Monday, pre-K and cluster teachers and staff must show up.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥公立学校向员工和家庭发出信函，其中提到：到了周一，学前班以及特殊集群的教师和员工必须到岗。

sentences.en: If you don't show up, you will be locked out from that software that allows you to teach remote.
sentences.zh: 如果你不到岗，你将被锁定在允许你进行远程教学的软件之外。

sentences.en: Where the city had threatened that if teachers didn't show up to work in person, they were actually going to lock teachers out of Google Classroom,
sentences.zh: 当时市政府威胁称，如果教师不亲自到校上班，他们实际上将把教师锁在谷歌课堂（Google Classroom）之外，

sentences.en: which is the platform that teachers were using to interact with kids.
sentences.zh: 这是教师用来与孩子们互动的平台。

sentences.en: And that is important because the union has said, you lock one of us out, you lock all of us out.
sentences.zh: 这一点很重要，因为工会已经表态：你们把我们其中一人锁在外面，就是把我们所有人都锁在外面。

sentences.en: And that lockout could trigger a strike.
sentences.zh: 而这种封锁可能会引发罢工。

sentences.en: I just want to pause and understand that threat.
sentences.zh: 我只想暂停一下，理解一下这个威胁。

sentences.en: So teachers, faced with a directive to come back to school, said, no, we don't like what the city of Chicago, your preparations look like.
sentences.zh: 因此，面对返校指令的教师们说，不，我们不喜欢芝加哥市政府做出的那些准备工作。

sentences.en: And the city of Chicago says, if you don't return to the classroom, we will lock you out of the software needed to teach remotely?
sentences.zh: 而芝加哥市政府则说，如果你不返回教室，我们就锁死你进行远程教学所需的软件？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's a heck of a threat.
sentences.zh: 这可真是一个了不得的威胁。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the reason why that is so shocking and such a sort of freighted thing to threaten is that the majority of parents that returned a survey in the city of Chicago asking them if they were ready to send their kids back to classrooms and if they wanted to do that,
sentences.zh: 之所以这么令人震惊，而且是一个充满火药味的威胁，原因在于芝加哥市回收的一份问卷调查显示，大多数家长被问及是否准备好让孩子重返教室以及是否愿意这样做时，

sentences.en: in fact, said no.
sentences.zh: 事实上，答案是否定的。

sentences.en: The majority of parents said that they wanted to continue teaching their kids remotely, having their kids at home.
sentences.zh: 大多数家长表示，他们希望继续让孩子进行远程学习，让孩子待在家里。

sentences.en: And it is a predominantly Black and Latino school district.
sentences.zh: 这是一个以黑人和拉丁裔为主的学区。

sentences.en: Those communities have borne the brunt of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这些社区承受了大流行带来的最大冲击。

sentences.en: And those parents are not really confident that now is the right time to send their kids back in many cases.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，这些家长对于现在是不是把孩子送回学校的好时机并没有太大信心。

sentences.en: So when the city made that threat to lock teachers out of the Google education platform,
sentences.zh: 所以，当市政府发出将教师排除在谷歌教育平台之外的威胁时，

sentences.en: who was that threat on behalf of if the majority of parents surveyed said that they wanted their kids at home using a Google remote learning platform?
sentences.zh: 如果接受调查的多数家长都表示希望孩子在家使用谷歌远程学习平台，那么这个威胁究竟是代表谁发出的？

sentences.en: Well, it was on behalf of two groups, I'd say.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想它是代表两个群体的。

sentences.en: First would be those parents who do want to go back.
sentences.zh: 首先是那些确实希望返校的家长。

sentences.en: Although that group is disproportionately white compared to the number of white families in Chicago, still the majority of kids in that group are also Black and Latino.
sentences.zh: 尽管与芝加哥的白人家庭数量相比，这个群体的白人比例过高，但该群体中的大多数孩子依然是黑人和拉丁裔。

sentences.en: You know, Mayor Lightfoot and the school superintendent have said that every parent does deserve that option.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，莱特富特市长和学校总监曾表示，每一位家长确实都理应拥有这种选择权。

sentences.en: And Mayor Lightfoot has spoken about, as a mother, observing her own 12-year-old daughter struggling with remote learning.
sentences.zh: 莱特富特市长曾谈到，作为一名母亲，她观察到自己12岁的女儿在远程学习时遇到了困难。

sentences.en: And she has said that if it is not good enough for her child and she doesn't feel like it is adequate for her kid, that it shouldn't be all that is offered to any child.
sentences.zh: 她曾表示，如果这种教育对她的孩子来说还不够好，她觉得对自己的孩子来说不够充分，那它就不应该成为提供给任何孩子的唯一选择。

sentences.en: But also, the mayor and school CEO did bring up several times that some families did not return this survey at all.
sentences.zh: 不过，市长和学校首席执行官也多次提到，确实有一些家庭根本没有回复这份调查问卷。

sentences.en: And these are the kids that, in many ways, educators are most worried about right now.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这些正是教育工作者目前最担心的孩子。

sentences.en: They are the ones who have sort of drifted away from the school system over the course of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们是在大流行期间逐渐与学校系统失去联系的那群人。

sentences.en: They are not logging in regularly to online classes.
sentences.zh: 他们没有定期登录在线课程。

sentences.en: They may not have an adult who's able to stay home from work to guide them through remote instruction.
sentences.zh: 他们可能没有一个能够辞职在家指导他们进行远程学习的成年人。

sentences.en: Their families may be suffering economically from the pandemic or having health issues related to the pandemic or just going through any one of the number of traumas that we know that the pandemic is causing.
sentences.zh: 他们的家庭可能正遭受大流行带来的经济打击，或面临与大流行相关的健康问题，或者只是在经历我们深知的大流行所带来的种种创伤之一。

sentences.en: And so what Mayor Lightfoot and the school CEO said was, these kids might come back if we reopen schools.
sentences.zh: 因此，莱特富特市长和学校首席执行官表示，如果我们重新开放学校，这些孩子可能会回来。

sentences.en: And, you know, we can't really get them back, maybe, until we do that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，也许在我们这样做之前，我们真的无法把他们找回来。

sentences.en: So both sides, both Mayor Lightfoot and the teachers unions, they're both arguing that they have the best interests of the kids that are most vulnerable in mind.
sentences.zh: 所以双方——无论是莱特富特市长还是教师工会，都在争辩说，他们心里想的都是最弱势群体的最大利益。

sentences.en: Both sides really are making that argument.
sentences.zh: 双方确实都在以此作为论据。

sentences.en: So what ends up happening in this pretty high-stakes standoff in Chicago?
sentences.zh: 那么在这场芝加哥高度紧张的对峙中，最终结果如何呢？

sentences.en: So all through the month of January and into February, there were these very tense negotiations between the union and the mayor's office and the school CEO.
sentences.zh: 所以在整个1月和2月期间，工会与市长办公室以及学校首席执行官之间进行了非常紧张的谈判。

sentences.en: And it all culminated after a weekend of all-nighters on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 这一切在经历了一个通宵达旦的周末后，于周日迎来了高潮。

sentences.en: So good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 那么，大家下午好。

sentences.en: We are here to announce the very good news that our children will be returning to in-person learning this week.
sentences.zh: 我们在此宣布一个好消息：我们的孩子将在本周恢复线下课堂学习。

sentences.en: When Mayor Lori Lightfoot stepped out in a news conference and announced a tentative deal with the Chicago Teachers Union to get kids back in school.
sentences.zh: 当洛里·莱特富特市长出席新闻发布会，并宣布与芝加哥教师工会达成一项旨在让孩子们重返校园的初步协议时。

sentences.en: CPS has finally reached a tentative agreement with the Chicago Teachers Union that opens up the school doors for safe in-person learning for our pre-K.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥公立学校终于与芝加哥教师工会达成了一项初步协议，为我们的学龄前儿童打开了安全线下学习的校门。

sentences.en: They said that they were going to accelerate vaccination for thousands of teachers to go as fast as they could on that.
sentences.zh: 他们表示将加快成千上万名教师的疫苗接种工作，尽最大努力全速推进。

sentences.en: But for those teachers who maybe weren't able to access a vaccine, if there aren't enough vaccine doses to go around,
sentences.zh: 但对于那些可能无法获得疫苗的教师，如果疫苗剂量不够分配，

sentences.en: they did say that they would have the option of taking an unpaid leave of absence for the next quarter instead of teaching in person.
sentences.zh: 他们确实表示，在下一季度他们可以选择请无薪假，而不是进行面授教学。

sentences.en: So it's not necessarily what that teacher wants, which is to continue to get paid for some sort of work from home.
sentences.zh: 所以这不一定符合该教师的意愿，即继续通过某种居家办公方式获得薪水。

sentences.en: But it does premise to protect that teacher's job during this time.
sentences.zh: 但它确实承诺在此时保护这位教师的工作岗位。

sentences.en: This agreement was about making sure everyone in our school communities just aren't safe,
sentences.zh: 这项协议旨在确保我们学校社区中的每个人不仅是安全的，

sentences.en: but also that they feel safe and feel that their lived experience and fears and frustrations have been heard.
sentences.zh: 而且还要让他们感到安全，并觉得他们的亲身经历、恐惧和沮丧情绪受到了倾听。

sentences.en: I imagine from the perspective of many teachers,
sentences.zh: 我可以想象，在许多教师看来，

sentences.en: the choice they're being given is essentially work and potentially put your loved ones at risk or ensure that your loved ones are safer, but you don't get paid.
sentences.zh: 他们被给予的选择基本上是：要么工作并可能让你的亲人面临风险，要么确保你的亲人更安全，但你没有薪水。

sentences.en: Yeah, and that's a really stark choice for an individual teacher to have to make.
sentences.zh: 是的，对于个别教师来说，这是一个非常残酷的选择。

sentences.en: But I think what you have to also think about is that many other essential workers have taken on a lot of risk to themselves and their families to work outside their homes during this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得你也得想想，在这场大流行期间，许多其他基本岗位的工作人员为了在室外工作，也承受了给自己和家人带来巨大风险的代价。

sentences.en: So if the teachers do decide to endorse this deal, when would they be back in the classroom?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果教师们决定批准这项协议，他们什么时候能回到教室？

sentences.en: So preschool and high needs kids, potentially those with disabilities that require special services, will be back on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 学前班和高需求儿童，比如那些需要特殊服务的残疾儿童，可能会在周四返校。

sentences.en: Elementary school students on March 1st and middle school students on March 8th.
sentences.zh: 小学生在3月1日返校，中学生在3月8日返校。

sentences.en: So pretty faSt.
sentences.zh: 所以速度相当快。

sentences.en: Yes, although Mayor Lightfoot did want the students back in January.
sentences.zh: 是的，尽管莱特富特市长原本希望学生们在1月份就返校。

sentences.en: So it is, you know, a pretty big shift in terms of the number of weeks of learning here.
sentences.zh: 所以，就这里的学习周数而言，这确实是一个相当大的转变。

sentences.en: And this does seem to fall within the Biden administration's desired timeline.
sentences.zh: 这似乎确实符合拜登政府期望的时间表。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And, you know, what we heard on background is that a lot of calls were going back and forth between the mayor's office, the school superintendent, the teachers' unions,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们听到内部消息称，市长办公室、学校总监、教师工会之间有很多电话往来，

sentences.en: and Washington.
sentences.zh: 还有华盛顿。

sentences.en: You know, potentially speaking to folks in the Biden administration and also to New York, where Randy Weingarten, the teachers' union president, is located.
sentences.zh: 可能与拜登政府的工作人员进行了对话，也与纽约进行了沟通，教师工会主席兰迪·温加滕就在那里。

sentences.en: And all of these people were negotiating with each other, talking, pushing each other, accommodating each other in some cases, fighting.
sentences.zh: 所有人都在互相谈判、对话、施压、在某些情况下妥协，甚至争吵。

sentences.en: And that's what it took to get to this agreement, which is still tentative and still very controversial with rank-and-file teachers in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 这就是达成这项协议所付出的代价，尽管它目前仍是初步协议，且在芝加哥的普通教师中仍极具争议。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So are we right to think of Chicago as a meaningful test case in this Biden goal of reopening schools by the 100-day mark of his administration?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们把芝加哥视为拜登政府在其执政百日大关前重新开放学校这一目标的有力测试案例，这种看法对吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为是的。

sentences.en: I mean, Chicago has a very feisty union that's always up for a fight.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，芝加哥有一个非常强势好斗、随时准备抗争的工会。

sentences.en: And if they can get to reopening in the next few weeks there, I think it will offer a path forward for those other places that remain closed.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能在接下来的几周内在当地实现重新开放，我认为这将为其他依然关闭的地区提供一条前进的道路。

sentences.en: But remember, this whole Biden push is only for K-8 schools.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，拜登的整个推动计划仅针对K-8学校（幼儿园到初中）。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the parents of high school kids are saying, what about us?
sentences.zh: 高中生的家长们则在问：我们呢？

sentences.en: When are our kids going to be part of this conversation?
sentences.zh: 我们的孩子什么时候能成为这场对话的一部分？

sentences.en: For those schools and cities maybe that don't manage to negotiate the reopenings this spring, we're then pushing to fall.
sentences.zh: 对于那些今年春天可能未能通过谈判实现重新开放的学校和城市来说，我们将不得不把工作推迟到秋季。

sentences.en: And for parents and students that left school in 2020, now we're talking about a third potentially disrupted school year.
sentences.zh: 而对2020年离开学校的家长和学生而言，我们现在谈论的是可能面临中断的第三个学年。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is going to be devastating for a lot of families.
sentences.zh: 这对许多家庭来说将是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's a lot riding on getting kids back into classrooMs.
sentences.zh: 让孩子们回到教室关系重大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's interesting because I just came back from a parental leave with a new baby.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这很有意思，因为我刚结束育儿假带着新出生的宝宝回来。

sentences.en: And I had thought when I stepped out to have my baby in August that I might be returning to the story of recovery, educational, social,
sentences.zh: 当我在8月份休假去生孩子时，我曾以为我回来时要报道的会是关于全国学生的复苏故事——教育、社会、

sentences.en: mental health recovery for the nation's students as kids were basically all back in school.
sentences.zh: 以及心理健康的恢复，因为当时孩子们基本上都已经重返校园了。

sentences.en: At some point this semester, I now think I'm going to be covering a very different story over the next six months.
sentences.zh: 在这个学期的某个时刻，我现在觉得在接下来的六个月里，我要报道一个截然不同的故事。

sentences.en: It's that the fight and debate over whether schools can be reopened and how they should be reopened in many parts of the country continues.
sentences.zh: 那就是在全国许多地方，关于学校能否重新开放以及应该如何重新开放的争斗和辩论仍在继续。

sentences.en: And it is not over at all.
sentences.zh: 而且远没有结束。

sentences.en: Thank you, Dana.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，达娜。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Tuesday afternoon, after we spoke with Dana, White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki seemed to lower expectations for President Biden's 100-day school reopening plan.
sentences.zh: 周二下午，在我们与达娜交谈后，白宫新闻秘书珍·普萨基似乎调低了外界对拜登总统100天学校重开计划的预期。

sentences.en: His plan, she said, was to have a majority of K-8 schools holding in-person classes for as little as one day a week.
sentences.zh: 她说，他的计划是让大多数K-8学校每周至少开展一天线下授课。

sentences.en: Hours later, in Chicago, the Teachers Union announced that its members had ratified the agreement with the city,
sentences.zh: 数小时后，在芝加哥，教师工会宣布其成员已正式批准了与市政府达成的协议，

sentences.en: paving the way for students to begin returning to classrooms there starting this week.
sentences.zh: 为学生从本周开始重返教室铺平道路。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Esteemed members of the Senate, going forward with this impeachment trial of a former president of the United States is unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 尊敬的参议员们，继续对一位美国前总统进行这项弹劾审判是违宪的。

sentences.en: And as a matter of policy, it is wrong, as wrong can be for all of us as a nation.
sentences.zh: 而且从政策层面来看，这是完全错误的，对我们整个国家而言错得离谱。

sentences.en: During the opening day of Donald Trump's impeachment trial, the Senate rejected the claim from his defense team that it would be unconstitutional to prosecute a former president.
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普弹劾审判的第一天，参议院否决了其辩护团队关于审判前总统属于违宪的主张。

sentences.en: The vote was 56 to 44, with six Republicans joining all 50 Democrats.
sentences.zh: 投票结果为56比44，有6名共和党人加入了全部50名民主党人的阵营。

sentences.en: However, the vote revealed just how little Republican support exists to convict Trump, something that would require 17 Republicans.
sentences.zh: 然而，投票结果也暴露出，共和党内支持给特朗普定罪的力量少得可怜，而这需要17名共和党人的支持。

sentences.en: After the vote, Democratic House impeachment managers began presenting their case that Trump incited an insurrection at the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 投票结束后，众议院民主党弹劾案检控官开始陈述他们的论点，即特朗普煽动了国会大厦的叛乱。

sentences.en: We're going to walk down to the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 我们要走向国会大厦。

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 好样的！

sentences.en: Take the Capitol!
sentences.zh: 占领国会大厦！

sentences.en: Take the Capitol!
sentences.zh: 占领国会大厦！

sentences.en: Take the Capitol!
sentences.zh: 占领国会大厦！

sentences.en: Take the Capitol!
sentences.zh: 占领国会大厦！

sentences.en: Beginning with a 13-minute video that juxtaposed Trump's words on January 6th with the riot that followed.
sentences.zh: 开场播放了一段13分钟的视频，将特朗普在1月6日的言论与随后的骚乱进行了对比。

sentences.en: Senators, the president was impeached by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 参议员们，美国总统于1月13日遭到众议院

sentences.en: House of Representatives on January 13th for doing that.
sentences.zh: 弹劾，原因正是因为这种行为。

sentences.en: After the video had concluded, the lead House manager, Democratic Rep.
sentences.zh: 视频播放结束后，众议院首席检控官、民主党众议员

sentences.en: Jamie Raskin, addressed the senators in the room directly.
sentences.zh: 杰米·拉斯金直接向在场的参议员们发表了讲话。

sentences.en: You ask what a high crime and misdemeanor is under our Constitution?
sentences.zh: 你们要问根据我们的宪法，什么是严重的罪行和轻罪？

sentences.en: That's a high crime and misdemeanor.
sentences.zh: 这就是严重的罪行和轻罪。

sentences.en: If that's not an impeachable offense, then there is no such thing.
sentences.zh: 如果这都不算可弹劾的罪行，那就没有什么罪行算得上了。

sentences.en: The next phase of the trial will begin today, when impeachment managers deliver their oral arguments to senators.
sentences.zh: 审判的下一阶段将于今天开始，届时弹劾案检控官将向参议员们发表口头辩论。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由西德尼·哈珀、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊和尼娜·波托克制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Dave Shaw and engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 剪辑由戴夫·肖完成，混音工程由克里斯·伍德负责。

sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 在本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是遮光睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会喝到断片才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
